experiences.title: Cut over to one canonical schema
experiences.summary: Use when a completed migration should remove dual readers and leave one current schema, not for an unrelated module refactor.
experiences.rule: After migration, remove compatibility readers and keep one canonical schema as the runtime truth.

experiences.title: Refactor module responsibilities at the root cause
experiences.summary: Use for a cohesive responsibility refactor that fixes the implementation cause without implying a schema cutover.
experiences.rule: Refactor responsibilities at the real boundary and fix the root cause without inventing migration work.

experiences.title: Execute an agent goal to closure
experiences.summary: Use when an agent goal is explicitly started and should be implemented and verified to completion.
experiences.rule: Treat an explicit agent goal as an execution protocol and continue through implementation and verification.

experiences.title: Run the final delivery gate
experiences.summary: Use after implementation for a final review, acceptance verdict, or pre-submit gate, not when merely starting a goal.
experiences.rule: Separate implementation completion from delivery readiness and issue an evidence-backed final verdict.

experiences.title: Validate an implemented frontend through the real path
experiences.summary: Use for an implemented visible frontend change that requires real browser and end-to-end validation.
experiences.rule: Exercise the implemented page through the real browser path and verify visible behavior and side effects.

experiences.title: Align product design with its design source
experiences.summary: Use for a UI or UX design judgment against DESIGN.md or a supplied design source, before implementation validation.
experiences.rule: Evaluate the product design against the explicit design source before adding implementation assumptions.

experiences.title: Keep Git worktree changes scoped to the task
experiences.summary: Use for a real local diff, stage, or commit-scope operation, not for a read-only diff review.
experiences.rule: Inspect the worktree and stage only the files that belong to the current task.

experiences.title: Require authorization for an irreversible action
experiences.summary: Use when an irreversible production or deletion action still requires explicit authorization.

ignore_when: local diff without an external action

experiences.rule: Do not perform an irreversible action until the user has explicitly authorized that exact scope.

experiences.title: Keep a temporary placeholder out of final delivery
experiences.summary: Use when a placeholder or mock is only temporary wiring and must be replaced by the real service before acceptance.

use_when: mock 不能作为最终验收

triggers: mock 不能作为最终验收

experiences.rule: Mark temporary wiring explicitly and replace it with the real service before final acceptance.

experiences.title: Separate environment failure from business failure
experiences.summary: Use for generic debugging where tool or environment failure must be separated from a business-rule failure.

use_when: 区分环境失败和业务失败
工具报错还是业务异常

triggers: 区分环境失败和业务失败
工具报错还是业务异常

experiences.rule: Prove whether the failure belongs to the environment, tooling, or business behavior before changing the implementation.

experiences.title: Validate message bridge state and delivery
experiences.summary: Use after operating a message bridge or bot when runtime state, logs, and real delivery must agree.

ignore_when: generic runtime debugging without a message service

experiences.rule: After a bridge operation, verify process state, logs, and an actual message delivery result in the same window.
